title: AGY PPT source-grounded QA report (Phase 12)
description: Layer B (deterministic) contract for the final grounded-QA report. This is a summary/report artifact, not a new source of truth: it aggregates source_inventory.json, claim_traceability.json, and source_coverage.json. It must clearly separate 'deterministic_findings' (computed by the Python validator: dangling references, unaccounted HIGH-priority units, missing required fields) from 'semantic_findings' (AGY's own judgement, persisted verbatim, never computed by this validator).

deterministic_findings.description: Computed only from structural facts: dangling references, missing required fields, unaccounted HIGH-priority units. Never a claim about semantic truth.

semantic_findings.description: AGY's own judgement, persisted verbatim by AGY. This validator never computes or infers these values; it only checks the shape is legal.
